id: \rI've beaten it before. It was fun I guess.
en: \rI've beaten it before. It was fun I guess.
it: \rL'ho già superata. È stato divertente, credo.

id: \rHala gives everyone a chance to try the trial. All you need is spunk.
en: \rHala gives everyone a chance to try the trial. All you need is spunk.
it: \rHala dà a tutti la possibilità di tentare la prova. Basta avere grinta.

id: \bYou need permission from Hala to enter this trial.
en: \bYou need permission from Hala to enter this trial.
it: \bTi serve il permesso di Hala per accedere a questa prova.

id: \bGood battle. I guess you deserve to advance.
en: \bGood battle. I guess you deserve to advance.
it: \bBella lotta. Direi che ti meriti di proseguire.

id: \bHow did Butterfree lose? I've had it since I started my journey.
en: \bHow did Butterfree lose? I've had it since I started my journey.
it: \bCome ha fatto Butterfree a perdere? Ce l'ho da quando ho iniziato il mio viaggio.

id: Rotom Dex: That's both of them. Let's head back to the professor.
en: Rotom Dex: That's both of them. Let's head back to the professor.
it: Rotom Dex: Abbiamo trovato entrambi. Torniamo dal professore.

id: \rI wonder what is out there in the sea.
en: \rI wonder what is out there in the sea.
it: \rChissà cosa c'è là fuori, nel mare.

id: \rI want to travel to Hoenn. I hear they have a lot of water too.
en: \rI want to travel to Hoenn. I hear they have a lot of water too.
it: \rVoglio andare a Hoenn. Ho sentito che anche lì c'è un sacco d'acqua.

id: \bKukui: Hey cousin. I see you beat your first trial. What did you get for it?
en: \bKukui: Hey cousin. I see you beat your first trial.  What did you get for it?
it: \bKukui: Ehi, cugino. Vedo che hai superato la tua prima prova.  Cosa ti hanno dato?

id: \bA Normalium Z, huh? With that you can finally use Z-Moves. Your Pokémon can use Z-Power now! But you can only use it once in a battle.
en: \bA Normalium Z, huh? With that you can finally use Z-Moves. Your Pokémon can use Z-Power now! But you can only use it once in a battle.
it: \bUn Normium Z, eh? Con quello puoi finalmente usare le Mosse Z. I tuoi Pokémon ora possono usare il potere Z! Ma puoi farlo una sola volta per lotta.

id: \bEach crystal is specific in what it can do. The one you just got will turn any Normal type move into a powerful attack.
en: \bEach crystal is specific in what it can do. The one you just got will turn any Normal type move into a powerful attack.
it: \bOgni cristallo ha un effetto specifico. Quello che hai appena ottenuto trasforma qualsiasi mossa di tipo Normale in un attacco potentissimo.

id: \bKukui: Your Pokémon can use Z-Power now! But you can only use it once in a battle.
en: \bKukui: Your Pokémon can use Z-Power now! But you can only use it once in a battle.
it: \bKukui: I tuoi Pokémon ora possono usare il potere Z! Ma puoi farlo una sola volta per lotta.
